description: This file defines a React component for handling OAuth callback redirects in a Next.js application. It reads URL query parameters such as code, state, status, message, and redirect, displays corresponding status information, and manages auto-redirection back to the main integrations page with relevant banner messages.

classes.name: StatusBadge
classes.description: A React component that displays a colored badge indicating the status ('success', 'error', 'pending', 'unknown') with styling.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackPage
methods.description: Main React component that handles the OAuth callback flow, including reading URL parameters, displaying status information, and managing optional auto-redirection.
